documents.text:
# Upload API authentication
For POST /upload, send the API token in the X-Project-Token header. This endpoint accepts file uploads.

# Upload API size limit
POST /upload accepts files up to 1048576 bytes (1 MiB). Larger requests return HTTP 413. Check the file size before sending.
